entries.mechanism: The Axiom/PolicyEngine leg applies the 2026 District of Columbia indexed bracket and deduction schedule, while the pinned TAXSIM leg applies 2024 law. The exact residual is therefore the documented law-vintage difference, not an Axiom-versus-PolicyEngine mismatch.
